name: io.github.ianderso/german-archives-mcp
title: German Archives (DDB; BW, NRW, Rhineland-Palatinate and Hesse registers)
description: German archive finding aids (DDB); civil and church registers of BW, NRW, RLP and Hesse.

environmentVariables.name: GERMAN_ARCHIVES_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk response cache, and for the APERTUS volume PDFs kept for reading further pages.

environmentVariables.name: GERMAN_ARCHIVES_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one request. Image downloads get 120 s to read.

environmentVariables.name: GERMAN_ARCHIVES_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between two requests to one host. Never below 2; database searches and APERTUS volume downloads wait 10.

environmentVariables.name: GERMAN_ARCHIVES_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so an archive can reach whoever runs the server.

environmentVariables.name: GERMAN_ARCHIVES_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: An existing folder. When set, the image tools save only inside it; needed to save under ~/Library, such as an iCloud Drive folder.

environmentVariables.name: GERMAN_ARCHIVES_PDF_CACHE_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days a downloaded APERTUS volume PDF is kept for reading further pages (at most 30).

environmentVariables.name: GERMAN_ARCHIVES_PDF_CACHE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Most megabytes of APERTUS volume PDFs kept on disk; the least recently read go first (at least 100).
